annotations.title: Highly skilled migrant / EU Blue Card salary check

description: Checks whether a salary meets the 2026 IND salary requirement for a Dutch highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) permit or an EU Blue Card. Holiday allowance does not count; a 13th month counts only when paid monthly. Also checks the 30% ruling salary norm.

includes_holiday_pay.description: The salary amount includes the 8% holiday allowance. Default false.

per.description: Whether salary is per year or per month. Default year.

permit.description: hsm = highly skilled migrant, bluecard = EU Blue Card. Default hsm.

recent_graduate.description: Graduated within the last 3 years or on an orientation-year permit (reduced norm). Default false.

salary.description: Gross salary in euros, as in the offer

thirteenth_month.description: A 13th month: none, paid as a lump sum (does not count), or paid in 12 monthly parts (counts). Default none.

under_30.description: Applicant is under 30 on the day the application is filed. Default false.

name: visa_salary_check
